description: Kernel memory slab management implementation for Zephyr RTOS, including slab initialization, allocation, freeing, and statistics.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_stats_raw
methods.description: Retrieves raw statistics of a memory slab.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_stats_query
methods.description: Queries current statistics of a memory slab.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_stats_reset
methods.description: Resets maximum utilization statistics of a memory slab.

methods.name: create_free_list
methods.description: Initializes the free list of a memory slab.

methods.name: init_mem_slab_obj_core_list
methods.description: Initializes all statically defined memory slabs.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory slab with buffer, block size, and number of blocks.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a block from the memory slab, with optional timeout.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated block back to the memory slab.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_runtime_stats_get
methods.description: Retrieves current runtime statistics of a memory slab.

methods.name: k_mem_slab_runtime_stats_reset_max
methods.description: Resets the maximum utilization statistic of a memory slab.
